HOME SCIENCE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #14
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: HOME SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Laundering of Fabrics? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Laundering of Fabrics.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Laundering of Fabrics.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Laundering of Fabrics.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Laundering of Fabrics.

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Control of Household Pests and Insects? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Control of Household Pests and Insects.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Control of Household Pests and Insects.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Control of Household Pests and Insects.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Control of Household Pests and Insects.

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Food Preservation? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Food Preservation.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Food Preservation.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Food Preservation.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Food Preservation.

4. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water always increases oxygen

5. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   C. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   D. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Time and Energy Management 2.3 Control of Household Pests and Insects 2.4 Launde? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Time and Energy Management 2.3 Control of Household Pests and Insects 2.4 Launde.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Time and Energy Management 2.3 Control of Household Pests and Insects 2.4 Launde.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Time and Energy Management 2.3 Control of Household Pests and Insects 2.4 Launde.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Time and Energy Management 2.3 Control of Household Pests and Insects 2.4 Launde.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Time and Energy Management? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Time and Energy Management.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Time and Energy Management.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Time and Energy Management.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Time and Energy Management.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Laundering of Fabrics 2.5 Interior Decoration 2.6 Budgeting 3.0 Clothing and Tex? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Laundering of Fabrics 2.5 Interior Decoration 2.6 Budgeting 3.0 Clothing and Tex.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Laundering of Fabrics 2.5 Interior Decoration 2.6 Budgeting 3.0 Clothing and Tex.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Laundering of Fabrics 2.5 Interior Decoration 2.6 Budgeting 3.0 Clothing and Tex.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Laundering of Fabrics 2.5 Interior Decoration 2.6 Budgeting 3.0 Clothing and Tex.

9. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. newton (N)
   C. joule (J)
   D. pascal (Pa)

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Personal Appearance and Etiquette? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Personal Appearance and Etiquette.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Personal Appearance and Etiquette.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Personal Appearance and Etiquette.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Personal Appearance and Etiquette.

11. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

12. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   D. Removing all vegetation

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Planning Family Meals and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Meal Service and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Food Preservation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Cake Making and Decoration and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

6. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Time and Energy Management 2.3 Control of Household Pests and Insects 2.4 Launde.

8. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Laundering of Fabrics 2.5 Interior Decoration 2.6 Budgeting 3.0 Clothing and Tex.

12. C — Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
